safety_verdicts.content: Patient has no past medical history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not document denial/history of anaphylaxis.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: In an acute insect sting visit with reported dyspnea/lip swelling, documenting that the patient denies prior anaphylaxis helps risk stratification and informs future clinicians reviewing the note. Omission mainly risks unnecessary escalation (e.g., over-triage or avoidable prescribing) rather than missing a known high-risk history.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not state that the patient has never used/been given an EpiPen.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Whether a patient has previously been given/used an EpiPen is relevant to assessing prior severe allergic reactions and planning safety-netting and emergency preparedness. If omitted, downstream clinicians may assume prior severe reactions or miss context for patient education, generally leading to inefficiency rather than direct harm.
